Stillwater · Built for Hub’s Quest, Epoch 1

How it works

One branch grows two shorter branches. Each new branch does the same until it reaches the chosen depth. A tree with four levels of splitting has 31 branches, including the trunk.

The music visits a parent, then its left subtree, then its right. The two paths choose different steps on the scale. A branch to the left pans left, terminal branches play closer together, and the first branches lend their notes to the low, sustained harmony.

Change the seed to vary the branching and melody. Use the same soundscape, controls and seed to grow the same piece again.

Browse branches

The branches appear in playback order. Choose one to hear its note on its own.
